$comment: Accept-list for dependency advisories that cannot be fixed within the currently pinned major versions. Every entry needs a GHSA id, the package name, the severity it was accepted at, a concrete reason, and an expiry date (UTC). Expired, stale, or severity-mismatched entries fail scripts/audit-deps.ts and force a re-review.
